name: UVC-AI-Theta-Pro
title: Camera AI Theta Pro
summary: Discreet 360-degree ceiling camera system: AI Theta Hub + 4K ProLens360 fisheye, PoE.

camera.ai: person/vehicle/animal; face/LPR only with wide-angle/long-distance lens
camera.audio: two-way with optional AI Theta Audio

requires: UniFi Protect on a console/NVR with storage

gotchas: Face/LPR only work with the separate Wide-Angle or Long-Distance lens (e.g. ProLens110) - not the included 360 lens.
Marketed '4K' but the 360 stream is 2160x2160 (4MP) at 24 fps.
No IR night vision listed; audio needs the optional AI Theta Audio.
Requires Protect on a console/NVR; sold out at scrape time.
